title: One colour: convert and fade
blurb: Single-colour color-mix() compared with relative colour syntax and the older ', transparent' fade idiom.
question: Is color-mix(in <space>, c [p%]) equivalent to relative colour syntax and to color-mix(in <space>, c p%, transparent)?
result: Equal to relative colour syntax in every space tested, and to the transparent idiom above 0%. At 0% they differ: the transparent idiom zeroes lightness and chroma.
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 160.0.8184.0 (Linux, headless) with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features, and Chrome 158.0.8127.36 without, on 2026-11-26

friction.summary: Variadic and single-colour color-mix() are rejected by the parser until the CSSColorMixVariadic runtime flag is on; Chrome 158 has no such flag.
friction.repro: Set style.color = 'color-mix(in srgb, red, lime, blue)' and read it back.
friction.workaround: Declare the nested two-colour value first and the variadic value second.
